text:
deploybot: [AUTO] SBOM scan failed for release/artifact redwood-api:v3.7.2 — licensing flag: ambiguous transitive license detected in package 'quirk-utils@2.1.0' (transitive). Blocking canary deploy. See: https://artifacts/internal/abc123 :warning:

maria: pinging @sara-legal and @kevin for license triage. change window opens in 2h, we need a decision to avoid rolling back.

sara-legal: looking. can you paste the relevant SBOM snippet?

deploybot: ```
package: quirk-utils@2.1.0
license: UNKNOWN (transitive via: legacy-io@1.4.0)
sha256: abcdef123456...
``` 

kevin: quick read — legacy-io is MIT, but quirk-utils has unclear CLA. this smells like a packaging metadata omission not a problematic license, but we need evidence.

maria: QA has a failing gateway test in canary, maybe unrelated. @tom-qa can you confirm if this is causing the test failure or separate?

tom-qa: failing test is a timeout against model-upload endpoint. logs don't reference quirk-utils. I think it's separate. :shrug:

sara-legal: OK — I can escalate to counsel if we can't confirm. two options: temporary exception for canary (timebox 24h) or block release until we get provenance from upstream.

lee-release: change-window ops: if we do exception, we must pin the transitive dep and add a release note + followup ticket to remove after upstream fix. Otherwise rollback to v3.7.1 now?

maria: preference is timeboxed exception to keep customer hotfix deploy. We can pin in the staging image with digest and lock rollout to EU only during canary.

kevin: technically feasible. we can patch image with pinned digest and instruct deploybot to route canary to eu region only. I'll prepare patch.

deploybot: acknowledged. created action: deploy/patch-pin-3301234567 with owner @kevin. will hold global rollout until manual approve. :white_check_mark:

sara-legal: I'll mark as temporary exception and attach counsel note. If upstream can't confirm license in 24h, we rollback. :ok_hand:

maria: thanks. @lee-release can you update release notes with "temporary license exception for transitive quirk-utils; pinned digest; rollback condition if not resolved in 24h" and tag infra/qa/legal?

lee-release: done — notes updated and release notes draft linked: https://docs/internal/release-notes/3301234567

oncall-bot: reminder — change window ends in 2h 10m. escalation policy active.

maria: closing loop — keeping canary in EU only, manual global approve after legal sign-off or automated rollback at +24h. I'll follow up in 8h.
